thread.title: Review Continuation Part 4
thread.preview:
**Full-module verdict: ACCEPT.**

I independently reviewed the exact `candidate/` in `DD_Campaign_Arcs_02_Local_Patch_01.zip` against the byte-preserved Return02 model/source ledger, the changed case records, both rebuilt chapters, review metadata, and the accepted EPI-01–14 interfaces.

**Reviewed archive:** `DD_Campaign_Arcs_02_Local_Patch_01.zip`  
**Bytes:** `329,908`  
**SHA-256:** `9d5a0027d11a3185fad24de05dafe07e7a665242282a555e63642ea4a893babd`

The candidate keeps `CAMPAIGN_ARCS_MODEL.json` and `SOURCE_HASHES.json` byte-identical to Return02, preserves all **78 case IDs in their existing order**, and changes only the three identified case records plus presentation/review material. I found **no remaining concrete authored-procedure blocker or source conflict** within the requested module scope.

### AR2 dispositions

**AR2-01 — AGREE.**  
The candidate Director chapter now uses the actual unchanged AIR identities rather than the Return02 presentation substitutions. In particular, `AIR-04` is Nomadic Human adaptation, `AIR-05` Winterfang Cold Resistance, `AIR-06` Elemental Shapeshifting/amphibious respiration, `AIR-07` Physical Conditioning, `AIR-10` Adaptive Perfection, and `AIR-11` Adaptive Mutation. Their real access predicates, costs, durations, limitations, source evidence, and local dispositions remain distinct. I found no invented universal immunity or resource bypass in the corrected rendering.

**AR2-02 — AGREE.**  
The corrected CF-1 procedure matches the unchanged machine model: when pressure is positive, closing I/E and opening V begins actual venting; **60 elapsed seconds of uninterrupted venting** are required before the gauge establishes zero. If zero is already verified, there is no artificial additional 60-second wait. Closing V early restarts the required complete interval. The corrected `ARC17-C29` sequence is coherent: opening Action completes at `t6`, readiness is invalidated immediately, the attempted print at `t12` is blocked during venting, and verified zero is reached at `t66`. The accepted `pressReady` completion is not altered.

**AR2-03 — AGREE.**  
Restoring `ARC15-C02` to the exact-Equinox equality case repairs a genuine example regression. The separate `ARC15-C10` continues to prove batch sealing, so the two cases now test different authored boundaries rather than duplicate each other.

**AR2-04 — AGREE.**  
`ARC16-C28` should not pretend that a sortie containing post-takeoff travel, abort, return, and later settlement lasts six seconds. The candidate correctly records wage entitlement at completed takeoff `t6`, leaves total elapsed time unresolved where the actual route duration is not provided, and transfers the real coins only at the subsequent actual settlement. The formula preserves real travel/resource time without inventing a free or fixed return interval.

**AR2-05 — AGREE.**  
The rebuilt chapters are materially better as the operative review reference. The Player chapter once again carries the material offer terms, exact deadline/equality handling, refusal alternatives, public vessel procedures, and complete press-facing instructions without exporting Director-only state. The Director chapter renders the unchanged model's operational content rather than relying on a short corrective appendix layered over stale prose. The mapping in `REGISTER.json` is appropriate audit evidence; it should not be construed as runtime testing.

I also find the specific omitted areas you identified restored at usable review depth: Veyr's actual cold defense; AIR-01–14; airlock breach/interlock/recovery handling; tactical movement/support/fuel/air/canopy procedures; Conclave evidence/custody/stock; A3 hostile-state and spindle-power behavior; full CF-1 service sequencing; contract termination/delivery/review/evidence/amendment/bond provisions; and the independent instructor-led refusal appointment.

**AR2-06 — AGREE.**  
The candidate correctly removes the accidental universal vessel-start requirement for serviceable cabin air. Departure legality now follows the actual support/anatomy/protection predicates, so a legitimately protected or no-breath occupant is not barred merely because cabin air is unnecessary for that occupant. The four-condition enumeration remains where it belongs: the contract-acceptance procedure.

## Complete candidate verdict

I **ACCEPT the complete corrected `candidate/` directory contained in `DD_Campaign_Arcs_02_Local_Patch_01.zip`, SHA-256 `9d5a0027d11a3185fad24de05dafe07e7a665242282a555e63642ea4a893babd`, as the current NEW provisional authored campaign-playtest reference for EPI-15–17.**

No further replacement text or JSON-pointer correction is required from this review.

This acceptance is limited to authored procedural/source coherence. It does **not** adopt canon, establish campaign era, resolve open cosmological identities, approve numerical balance, claim runtime execution or human playtesting, establish whole-game completion, approve publication readiness, or approve unseen later material. Accepted EPI-01–14 and the original source authorities remain unchanged.

content.text:
I received your complete Return02 and preserved it byte-for-byte. The 86 local source-integrity checks pass, with 51 unchanged source bindings and 78 case IDs. Independent reading found six remaining presentation/example regressions. I have prepared the exact corrections for your review in the attached DD_Campaign_Arcs_02_Local_Patch_01.zip: 329,908 bytes, SHA-256 9d5a0027d11a3185fad24de05dafe07e7a665242282a555e63642ea4a893babd.

Please review candidate/ against original-return02/, INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.json and the supplied evidence. CAMPAIGN_ARCS_MODEL.json and SOURCE_HASHES.json remain byte-identical to Return02. The candidate changes the two chapters, only three case records, and review metadata. All 78 IDs/order are preserved. The package also preserves the full original return; nothing has been deleted. The 996 local checks verify preservation, references, field coverage and selected arithmetic, not semantic correctness, runtime execution or human playtesting.

AR2-01: The Director supplement reassigned AIR IDs to different topics. The patch renders the actual unchanged model rows and their access/evidence/dispositions, including Nomadic Human AIR-04, Winterfang AIR-05, Elemental Shapeshifting AIR-06, Physical Conditioning AIR-07, Adaptive Perfection AIR-10 and Adaptive Mutation AIR-11.

AR2-02: The chapters changed CF-1 into sixty seconds of holding gauge zero; the model instead requires sixty elapsed seconds venting positive pressure, then verified zero, with no wait if zero is already verified. Both chapters now use the complete plate instructions. C29 starts the vent interval on completion of the opening Action at t6, blocks the attempted print at t12, and reaches verified zero at t66. Your accepted current pressReady guard stays unchanged.

AR2-03: Return02 replaced C02's original exact-Equinox completion scenario with a batch example, duplicating new C10. The patch restores the exact Return01 C02 and retains C10 separately.

AR2-04: C28 narrates takeoff, later abort/return and settlement but reports six total seconds. The patch uses elapsedSeconds=null with an explicit formula including actual travel/return/settlement, records wage entitlement at t6, and moves coins only at the later actual meeting.

AR2-05: Return02 shortened the Player chapter and dropped material terms, exact deadline equality, relic interfaces and refusal choices. The patch starts with the fuller Return01 chapter, applies the current corrections, and includes all 14 contract clauses, complete press plates and operations, and public vessel procedures. The Director chapter now renders every operative field of the unchanged model, including the actual source evidence and the three preserved schematic maps. REGISTER records the 961 field mappings and reversible player edits. This is a complete review reference; final publishing layout remains a separate task.

AR2-06: The new prose adds four universal vessel-start prerequisites, although the earlier four-condition correction concerned contract acceptance. Serviceable cabin air is not a blanket powered-support prerequisite for a legally protected/no-breath crew and party. The patch uses the unchanged model's actual anatomy, protection and support predicates and keeps the four-condition list with the contract.

Please independently disposition AR2-01 through AR2-06 and review the entire exact corrected candidate for internal consistency and the accepted EPI-01–14 interfaces. If acceptable, explicitly confirm the exact archive hash and the complete candidate as a NEW provisional authored campaign-playtest reference. If further corrections are required, give precise JSON pointers or unique before/after text and source reasons, preserving all unchanged material. Do not regenerate or shorten the full chapters. A list of agreement with the findings alone is not a whole-module verdict.

No new cosmological identity, campaign era, canon adoption, balance approval, runtime execution, human playtesting, whole-game completion or publication approval is requested. EPI-01–14 and all original sources remain unchanged. Please return your exact review and full-module verdict in this same conversation.

[User attached 1 file; file contents were not included]
